spans.s: (fr. भवस् voc. of भवत्, q.v.; before vowels and soft consonants भो; before hard consonants भोस् and भोः; the latter form also in pause, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 17 &c.; but there is occasional confusion of these forms, esp. in later literature; often also भोभोः.), an interjection or voc. particle commonly used in addressing another person or several persons = O! Ho! Hallo!, in soliloquies = alas! ŚBr. &c. &c. (according to L. a particle of sorrow and of interrogation).
भोस्—कार m. rules of address, Divyāv.
